answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 14020 Country: India Title: aok, kindly tell me the sunnat of keeping moustaches (either be clean shaved or trimmed by scissors) Question: aok, kindly tell me the sunnat of keeping moustaches ( either be clean shaved or trimmed by scissors ) Answer ID: 14020 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1009/1009=M/1430) Trim the moustache well by scissors that it is close to shaving and the lips are clearly seen: حلق الشارب بدعۃ وقیل سنۃ ( الدر المختار ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
